rule: A bad metric is worse than a missing metric because it creates false confidence.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Two incompatible democracy blocks shared D01–D04 IDs (legacy titles vs framework titles).
questions.reproducibly_observable: ID collision is an architecture defect, not a statistic.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Duplicate IDs destroy concept fit by making retrieval ambiguous.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No — researchers would not know which D03 was meant.

adjudications.rationale: Preserve historical lineage via remap table. Framework keeps D01–D04. Legacy voter participation MERGES into D03; civic engagement / public trust / local participation REMAP to D09–D11.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Storefront / Main Street commercial occupancy — geography, sector, and vacancy definition undefined.
questions.reproducibly_observable: No authoritative national Census/BLS scalar for 'Main Street occupancy'.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Any convenient proxy (retail employment, commercial vacancy indexes) would misrepresent the construct.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No — without a locked inventory method, answers diverge by source.

adjudications.rationale: Keep the concept visible as a research question. Do not fill with a national proxy. Local pilots may later invent a defensible ADMINISTRATIVE COUNT / STRUCTURAL INDICATOR.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Share of firms/employment/equity under 'local' ownership — entity, control, and geography undefined.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Potentially yes after lock (e.g., Census ABS / ownership tables), not yet.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Current title is too vague; a weak proxy would create false confidence.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: Not until geography/entity/control criteria are locked.

adjudications.rationale: Retain as countable empirical candidate. Explicit definition debt. No number in this slice.

questions.what_exactly_measured: 'Regulatory burden' as a single national scalar — pages of CFR, compliance cost, restrictiveness indexes, etc.
questions.reproducibly_observable: No single accepted official scalar; competing constructs.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Normatively loaded; convenient indexes measure chosen methodology more than a settled concept.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No — reasonable researchers pick different burden proxies.

adjudications.rationale: Remove from baseline scoreboard masquerade. Remains a research/normative measurement debate, not a Phase-2 baseline statistic.

questions.what_exactly_measured: AI investment — software, R&D, capex, startups, or public budget? Boundary unlocked.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Possible after boundary lock (BEA/NSF/private capital series), not before.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Private VC headlines are not a substitute for a locked national construct.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: Not until the investment boundary is governed.

adjudications.rationale: Keep as countable candidate (likely DERIVED). Do not source from unlocked private tallies in this slice.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Community Health Index coverage — an index CC intends to design.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Not an existing observed series.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Title already admits design agenda; keeping it as baseline_pending falsifies empirics.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No baseline retrieval exists.

adjudications.rationale: Park as design target. Does not count toward baseline scoreboard until a governed observed/derived index exists.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Independent oversight durability under unified government — institutional quality construct.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Not a single official series; requires coding rules and case judgment.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Institutional quality judgment ≠ baseline statistic.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No — coding schemes would diverge without a locked protocol.

adjudications.rationale: Move off scoreboard. Remains an important democracy research question for later structured coding, not a fillable baseline cell.

questions.what_exactly_measured: White-collar / economic crime enforcement intensity — rate per what population/base?
questions.reproducibly_observable: Possible administrative counts (DOJ/FBI/USSC) after definition lock; no locked intensity rate now.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Raw case counts without intensity definition are a weak proxy.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: Not until offense class, agency universe, and rate base are locked.

adjudications.rationale: Retain countable candidate. Definition debt explicit. No stuffed proxy.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Multiple-pathway secondary completion / credential attainment composite.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Component series exist (NCES); composite does not until governed.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Bachelor's-or-higher alone distorts the multiple-pathway concept.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: Not until composite membership and ages are locked.

adjudications.rationale: Keep countable. Reject bachelor's-or-higher substitute. Definition lock required before sourcing.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Hospital access — travel-time, closure, or capacity?
questions.reproducibly_observable: No single authoritative national access scalar ready for this slot.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Beds ≠ access; HPSA primary-care belongs to E05; overnight stays ≠ geographic access.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: Not until access construct is locked.

adjudications.rationale: Keep countable with explicit rejected substitutes. No number this slice.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Employer satisfaction with pathway graduates.
questions.reproducibly_observable: No federal statistical series.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Any ad-hoc survey would be a new research instrument, not a baseline retrieve.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No shared official answer exists.

adjudications.rationale: Park as research question / future survey design. Not a baseline scoreboard cell.

questions.what_exactly_measured: Public-service and transparency inventory / audit constructs.
questions.reproducibly_observable: Require custom inventories/audits, not one agency table.
questions.measures_intended_concept: Treating them as ordinary baseline statistics creates false confidence.
questions.outside_researcher_same_answer: No — answers depend on unfinished inventory methodology.

adjudications.rationale: Park PS01–PS08 and T01–T08 as design/measurement-build indicators. May return later as ADMINISTRATIVE COUNT after inventory methodology locks. Do not count toward empirical baseline scoreboard now.
